t: The Hut Cafe Sai Kung | Trip.com Hong Kong
s: January 13, 2025 - #chinatrip Oops opposite Sai Kung Pier Bus Stop has changed hands😮 The rooftop opened on the night of Lunar New Year's Eve still has the name of the previous one👀 The new store is named The Hut with a small storefront🏠 Not much has changed inside and outside the shop🧐 The third day of trial operation is here 🚶🏻♂️ The coffee shop specializes in Souffle pancakes😍 Tried the original and strawberry both were good light enough and enough egg flavor 🍓🥞 The coffee is a darker roasted nutty flavor with sweets just right ☕️ My friend happened to move from Sheung Wan to Sai Kung to work these two days💻 There is no need to go up the mountain to buy Indigo takeaway and then go down the mountain⛰️ Buy a sea salt caramel pancake and mocha🍯🥞🥤 It's much easier to walk through two streets on a flat road😌 #foodie #food
